#Rel Abundances
datList <- NULL 
for(con in unique(seuratM$pat_patho)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, pat_patho==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(pat_patho=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

## [1] 45737   104

dat_all <- do.call("rbind", datList)

## plot abundance
ggbarplot(dat_all, x= "pat_patho", y= "percent", fill = "Var1", palette = colclusterName, legend = "right", legend.titel = "cluster", ylab = "frequency")  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=ordpat_patho)

#Filter for Tcell cluster
filteredTcell <- dat_all%>%
  filter(Var1 == "Tcell")

View(filteredTcell)

# Tcell 8.9% in ACR0
# Tcell 14.8% in ACR1R
# Tcell 27.8% in ACR2R

cell_count <- data.frame(table(seuratM$pat_patho))
#view(cell_count)
colnames(cell_count) <- c ("Pathology", "Freq")
hsize <- 1.5

ggplot(cell_count, aes(x=hsize, y=Freq, fill = Pathology)) +
  geom_col(color="white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim (c(0.2, hsize + 0.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle ("Cell Number") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))

#Relative Abundances

datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$pat_patho)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, pat_patho==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(diseaseCond=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}

# Clean assignment
seuratM$diseaseCond <- NULL

# Reassign 
### diseaseCond
seuratM$diseaseCond <- "diseaseCond"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V1", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit1"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V2|353921_12-12_20240515_Hu_nucseq_USZ_EMB010_V1_2", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit2"
#Exclude rejection sample CarTrans019/3 from visit3 to get convalescence baseline
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V3", seuratM$dataset)& !(seuratM$dataset %in% "384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3")] <- "visit3" #Exclude rejection sample CarTrans019/3 from visit3 
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V4", seuratM$dataset)& !(seuratM$dataset %in% "372561_10-10_20241204_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx007_V4")] <- "visit4" #Exclude rejection sample CarTrans007/4 from visit4
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V5", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit5" 
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("VX1|VX2|VX3|VX4|384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3|372561_10-10_20241204_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx007_V4", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visitX"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("HH", seuratM$dataset)] <- "donorheart"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("RV|LV|expLV|expRV|331571_3-5_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx001|331571_4-6_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx002", seuratM$dataset)] <- "explant"

orddiseaseCond <- c("donorheart", "visit1", "visit2", "visit3", "visit4", "visit5", "visitX", "explant")

###diseaseCond
datList <- NULL
for(con in unique(seuratM$diseaseCond)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratM, diseaseCond==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(diseaseCond=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}
